name: dash-sites
description: Websites on Dash Platform DPNS names: builder, gateway and browser extension

scripts.build: tsc -b && npm run bundle -w @dash-sites/gateway && npm run bundle -w @dash-sites/cli && node packages/extension/build.mjs && node packages/builder/build.mjs && SITE=1 NETWORK=mainnet GATEWAY_DOMAIN=dash.site node packages/builder/build.mjs && node packages/shell/build.mjs && node packages/showcase/build.mjs
